You credit cognitive convergence on globe geometry (Eratosthenes, medieval Islamic astronomy) as scientific progress while reserving the cognitive-universals dismissal for convergence that happens to match the dome. That is selective epistemology.'
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: The current text handles the topology-shared observation ('the convergence is at the level of ORIENTATION and HIERARCHY, not physical structure; it converges with mutually contradictory cosmologies') but still does not directly rebut the epistemology-inversion move. A one-sentence addition would close it: the reason cognitive convergence on flat-disc-with-central-mountain does NOT count as evidence is that the SAME convergence appears in geometrically incompatible cosmologies (spherical Aryabhatan Meru, three-tiered Norse Yggdrasil, perimeter-encircling Qaf), so it discriminates orientation/hierarchy universals — precisely what Lakoff and Johnson document as embodied metaphor — not physical geometry. This is the strongest remaining open flank and the best next content edit, but it is low-urgency: NOT a new hole introduced by the patch, and the verdict does not depend on it. Deliberately not raised as a numbered hole to avoid a polish-churn loop on a target reviewed 11 times.

kernel_of_truth.description: The six-text convergence on a cosmic mountain 'in the north' is a real, well-attested Ancient Near East tradition (data/wins.json:WIN-031.detail_evidence, paragraph 2): the Zaphon-Zion typology, with Isaiah 14:13 'sides of the north', Psalm 48:2 identifying Mount Zion, Job 26:7 / 37:22 and Ezekiel 1:4 directional-north imagery, and 1 Enoch 17-18 supplying the visionary geography. The dome author did not fabricate the convergence, and the c11-verified text credits it fairly (detail_evidence paragraph 2, 'The dome author is not inventing the convergence').
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The convergence is retrodictive — the texts predate the model by ~2-3 millennia (data/wins.json:WIN-031.detail_evidence paragraph (1)) — so it cannot be a confirmed prediction; the axis-mundi archetype fits mutually contradictory cosmologies (Puranic Meru at r=0 flat-disc vs Aryabhatan Meru at a spherical pole; Norse Yggdrasil three-tier; Islamic Qaf perimeter — detail_evidence paragraph (2)), giving it zero discriminating power between geometries; and the WIN is nevertheless counted in the dome's 69-confirmed/94.5% scorecard (raw-text/02b-wins-V51-win064.txt, 'Confirmed Wins (69)') alongside empirically tested claims like WIN-029 Schumann frequency, pricing theological convergence at par with data-grounded physics.
